		visible = {

		effects = {
			tb_edit_click = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_tb_ver = 1 } } }
					mod1440_tb_default = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tb_setup = 1 } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_tb_setup = 0 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { mod1440_tb_setup = 1 }
				}
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = {
			always = no
